|game_text=Deploy on table. Dack Ralter and Wes Janson have [Pilot] 2. During your control phase, may take one Attack Pattern Delta, Desperate Tactics, Lucky Shot, One More Pass, Rapid Fire, or a vehicle weapon into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May lose 2 Force to cancel Trample or Walker Barrage. (Immune to Alter.)

The [[Nick Of Time (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth) (Original)|original-edition slip]] survives in the exact release PDF created on 4 February 2003. The sheet gives 5 February as the sanctioned legality date. The [[Nick Of Time (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth) (Remastered 2006)|2006 publication]] gives its text as of 4 December 2006.
